$comment: Stackra file contract: Purpose: the shape of stackra.lock.yaml, the workspace's pin of every external producer manifest. Boundary: shape only; `stackra gen` resolves the revisions. Runtime: node (editors and validators). Governing contract: ADR 0158 (the manifest is the contract), ADR 0260 (clients are generated from manifests), ADR 0231 (module keys).
title: stackra.lock.yaml
description: The pinned revision of every external producer manifest this workspace builds clients from, once per workspace. `stackra gen` reads each producer's committed `.stackra/app-manifest.json` at this revision, and every generated `clients.ts` header cites it (ADR 0158, ADR 0260). Producer to revision only: no secret and no URL. A producer that lives in this repository is not listed; its manifest is read from the working tree.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema. Editors use the `# yaml-language-server: $schema=` comment instead.

version.description: Lock file format version. Only 1 exists.

repository.description: This workspace's repository name, the same value as the root runway `project`.

producers.description: Producer module key → git revision of its committed `.stackra/app-manifest.json`. Bumping a revision is one commit that regenerates every member.
producers.$comment: Keys are module keys (ADR 0231: lowercase words joined by `_` or `-`). Values are commit SHAs, never a branch or tag, so a build is reproducible.

additionalProperties.description: Git commit SHA in the producer repository (7 to 40 lowercase hex characters).
